title: CacheRow
description: One compiled step in the trajectory cache. pool_eligible is explicit and fail-closed: anything not on the B5 allowlist is tenant-scoped.

program.description: The program this row is a step of (ADR-0013). Denormalized onto every row because the store is a flat append-only log with one record shape. steps_total is what lets a resolver distinguish a complete task from a truncated one: without it, rows 0-3 of an 8-step flow are indistinguishable from a complete 4-step flow, and every individual row is valid either way. Optional: rows written before #120 do not carry it, and a resolver treats its absence as a MISS with a reason rather than assuming completeness.

program_id.description: prog-<trajectory_id>. A naming convention, not a parsed format — see src/shared/program-id.ts.

steps_total.description: Step count of the complete program. Rows are step_index 0..steps_total-1.

compiled_at.description: When the compiler produced this program. Breaks ties when a task has been recompiled and two program versions are both resolvable.

pre_actions.description: ADR-0024 (#213): actions run, in order, before compiled_action. Written only by a repair rewrite, for churn that adds an action. The step's assertion is checked once, after compiled_action. Each item's locators are classified for the pool exactly like compiled_action's; a pre-action that loses every locator makes the row pool-ineligible. Absent means none.

wait_ms.description: For wait actions: the recorded duration in milliseconds (ADR-0008).

locator_fallback_chain.description: Ordered locators from trajectory candidates after taint filtering.

assertion.description: Embedded assertion object conforming to assertion.schema.json.

confidence.description: Empirical confidence from success/(success+failure); 0 if never verified.

pool_eligible.description: True ONLY if row content is entirely on the positive allowlist (B5). Default false.

pool_ineligible_reason.description: Required when pool_eligible=false. Null when eligible.

flow_topology.description: Pool-safe structural summary of the step's place in the flow.

invalidated_at.description: ISO timestamp at which confidence first fell below the invalidation threshold, or null when the row is not invalidated (ADR-0009). Stored rather than derived from confidence so that later tuning of the threshold cannot retroactively relabel history. Invalidated rows are kept, never deleted.

repair_provenance.description: Present only on a row written by a repair rewrite (ADR-0009): the recorded action failed and a different one passed. Links the new version to the repair that produced it.

replaced_action_type.description: Action type of the version this one replaced.

pre_action_count.description: Pre-actions the repair left on the step (ADR-0024). Absent means none.
